title: Inheritance without regard to number of common ancestors in the same generation.
bodyText: An heir shall inherit without regard to how many common ancestors in the same generation the heir shares with the decedent.
bodyHtml: §560:2-107  Inheritance without regard to number of common ancestors in the same generation.  An heir shall inherit without regard to how many common ancestors in the same generation the heir shares with the decedent. [L 1996, c 288, pt of §1; am L 2023, c 158, §13]
